Terrific Restaurant in the heart of the Old Quarter, with a view over the city
Mar 2025 • Couples
A very pleasant surprise to have such great quality food with amazing service, at the hotel where we were staying. The views from the 10th floor restaurant overlooked the old quarter of Hanoi. Breakfast was a delicious buffet plus could order off the menu. And dinner was amazing! Very fresh ingredients and the Vietnamese food is very authentic. Special shout out to Sun and May for their kind and friendly care during the meals. Highly recommended!

Fabulous personalised service & a delicious special food menu.
Feb 2025 • Business
Fabulous personalised service provided for our business conference group, having been met with signage at the entrance as well as being met by the staff & personally by the GM at the venue entrance. 
It’s a stunning restaurant & the roof top views are special. The menu was personally printed for us. The food was amazing both in quantity & quality and having the traditional musical instrument being played during our was a bonus. Highly recommend the Cocina.
